title: Team that delegates to two Players
statement: Define a Player class with a constructor that takes a number of goals, and a Goals method that returns it. Define a Team class that has two Players as attributes, takes their goals in its constructor, and a TotalGoals method that returns the sum by delegating to each Player. Read both players' goals, create the team and write the total.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with classes.
